name: Andrés Arrieta
biography: Andrés Arrieta is the Technology Projects Manager for the Electronic Frontier Foundation. A Telecom and Electronics Engineer, he previously worked for Mobile Operators managing and developing projects from the Radio and Core networks to IT systems like Spotify Premium for Movistar. Seeing the state of privacy in the digital world from previous experiences, he joins the EFF to help develop tools that address these issues.
